eku_mismatch.description: Leaf has only clientAuth EKU; verifying for serverAuth fails.

expired.description: Expired leaf: same chain verified at 2027-06-01, after the leaf notAfter (2026-01-01).

expired_intermediate.description: Intermediate CA already expired at 2022-01-01; verified 2025-06-01 -> EXPIRED on the intermediate.

good.description: Valid chain: root -> intermediate -> leaf, in date, serverAuth EKU, SAN example.test, verified at 2025-06-01.

hostname_mismatch.description: Chain is valid, but the requested host 'attacker.test' is not in the certificate SAN.

non_ca_intermediate.description: Intermediate certificate has basicConstraints CA:FALSE (and no keyCertSign); it must not be used to sign/issue the leaf.

not_yet_valid.description: Leaf notBefore is 2025-01-01 but verification runs 2024-06-01.

path_length_violation.description: Root has basicConstraints pathLenConstraint=0 but a CA intermediate is present, violating RFC 5280 4.2.1.9.

same_name_intermediate.description: Two intermediates share a subject DN; only one chains to the anchor. The builder must follow signatures, not names.

same_name_rogue_root.description: A rogue CA shares the trusted root's exact subject DN but has a different key. Name matching alone would be fooled; signature/SPKI validation rejects the rogue chain.

untrusted_root.description: Chain is internally valid but its root is not in the explicitly supplied trust store.

wildcard.description: Wildcard SAN *.example.test must match one label only.
